blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Finding the right video often requires distinguishing similar scenes in which different events occur. Joint matching improves retrieval, but processing rich video representations for each query is costly. VEDJE compresses features within sampled frames while keeping their representations separate in a reusable cache. Feature-change prediction supplies an auxiliary training signal that improves retrieval from the compressed cache without adding work at query time. On MSR-VTT, MSVD, DiDeMo, and ActivityNet, VEDJE improves R@1 over matched first-stage retrievers in both retrieval directions. On MSR-VTT, it reaches 59.8 text-to-video R@1 with a fine-tuned VideoCLIP-XL first stage. In the VideoPrism configuration, shrinking the per-video cache fourfold to 12 KiB preserves text-to-video recall within 0.2 points. These results show that accurate video search can operate on compact evidence, encoded once and reused as new queries arrive.
blocks.zh: 寻找正确的视频往往需要区分发生不同事件的类似场景. 联合匹配可以改善检索,但处理每个查询的丰富的视频表述费用高昂. VEDJE在采样框内压缩特征,同时将其表达式在可重复使用的缓存中分开. 特性变化预测提供辅助训练信号,改进从压缩缓存的检索,而不在查询时添加工作. 在MSR-VTT,MSVD,DiDeMo,以及ActiveNet上,VEDJE在两个检索方向上改进了匹配的第一阶段检索器R@1. 在MSR-VTT上,它以微调的VideoCLIP-XL第一阶段达到59.8文本对视频R@1. 在 VideoPrism 配置中,将 per-video 缓存缩写为 4 倍到 12 KiB 保留 0.2 点之内的文本到视频召回. 这些结果显示,准确的视频搜索可以在紧凑的证据上操作,一次编码,随着新查询的到来再使用.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video search at scale runs in two stages: a first stage retrieves plausible candidates over the full index, and a second stage verifies whether each candidate matches the query. This verification step must distinguish videos that share similar scenes but differ in the actions, state changes, or specific moments described by the query.
blocks.zh: 规模的视频搜索分两个阶段进行:第一阶段在完整的索引上检索到可信的候选人,第二阶段核实每个候选人是否符合查询要求。 这个校验步骤必须区分分享类似场景但在动作,状态变化,或查询所描述的特定时刻上有所不同的视频.

blocks.en: Dual-encoder retrieval stages ( Luo et al., 2022 ; Ma et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024b ) index videos and queries independently to retrieve candidates cheaply, but compute similarity without joint token interaction. Joint rerankers, mature for image retrieval ( Li et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023a ) , restore cross-modal attention. For video, however, both stored features and joint scoring sequences scale with the sampled frames, while re-encoding candidates online incurs severe latency. Multimodal LLM (MLLM) rerankers ( Ko et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) provide expressive joint matching, but place multi-billion-parameter decoders directly on the query path.
blocks.zh: 双编码器检索阶段(Luo等,2022;Ma等,2022;Wang等,2024a;Wang等,2024b) 索引视频和查询独立检索,以廉价检索考生,但计算相似性,不进行联合符号交互. 联合收缩器,成熟后用于图像取回(Li等,2022;Li等,2023a),恢复跨模式关注. 然而,对于视频来说,存储的功能和与被采样的相框的联合评分序列比例,而重新编码的在线考生则会出现严重的延迟. 多式联运LLM(MLLM)再排序器(Ko等,2025;Lee等,2025)提供显式联合匹配,但将数十亿参数解码器直接放入查询路径.

blocks.en: One way to keep verification deployable is to remove the visual encoder from the query path. The image cached reranker Edje ( Taraday et al., 2026 ) already shows how for static images: encode each image once offline, store a small set of compressed tokens, and rerank online with a lightweight joint encoder.
blocks.zh: 保持可验证性的一种方法是从查询路径中去掉可视编码器. 图像缓存的Ranker Edje(Taraday等,2026年)已经显示静态图像如何:每张图像一旦下线就编码,存储了一小组被压缩的代币,并用轻量级联合编码器在网上重新排序.

blocks.en: A video cache must be built before the queries it will serve are known. It must therefore retain evidence for descriptions of different objects, actions, and moments, while remaining small enough to store and score at scale. VEDJE addresses this problem by compressing features within sampled frames and retaining separate representations across sampled times. A lightweight joint encoder then reads these representations alongside the query. Feature-change supervision improves retrieval from the compressed tokens without adding computation to the query path.
blocks.zh: 视频缓存必须先被构建,然后才能知道它将会发送的询问. 因此,它必须保留对不同物体、行动和瞬间进行描述的证据,同时保持足够小以储存和分数。 VEDJE通过在被采样的框架内压缩特征来解决这个问题,并在被采样的时间之间保留单独的表示. 轻量级联合编码器随同查询阅读这些表述. 特性变化监督改进了从被压缩的令牌上取回,而不会给查询路径添加计算.

blocks.en: Offline, a frozen visual encoder processes each video once, and a shared compressor extracts a few learned tokens per sampled frame. At query time, a 33M-parameter cross-encoder scores the cached tokens alongside the query text and first-stage score. The token budget determines both per-video storage and the visual sequence length presented to the online scorer.
blocks.zh: 下行,一个被冷冻的视觉编码器处理每个视频一次,一个共享的压缩机抽取出每个被采样的相框的几个被学习到的符号. 在查询时间,一个33M参数的交叉编码器在查询文本和第一阶段分数的同时对缓存的符号进行分数. 符号预算既决定了每个视频存储,也决定了向在线计分员呈现的可视序列长度.

blocks.en: Across MSR-VTT ( Xu et al., 2016 ) , MSVD ( Chen and Dolan, 2011 ) , DiDeMo ( Hendricks et al., 2017 ) , and ActivityNet ( Krishna et al., 2017 ) , VEDJE consistently improves R@1 in both retrieval directions over matched first-stage retrievers. On MSR-VTT, it reaches 59.8 text-to-video R@1 with a fine-tuned VideoCLIP-XL first stage (Figure 1 ). In the VideoPrism configuration, allocating just one cached token per sampled frame reduces cache storage fourfold to 12 KiB per video while preserving T2V R@1 within 0.2 points. Controlled comparisons evaluate cache structure, feature-change training, and joint scoring, while complete-query measurements benchmark practical retrieval latency.
blocks.zh: 纵观MSR-VTT(徐等,2016年),MSVD(陈和多兰,2011年),DiDeMo(Hendricks等,2017年),以及ActiveNet(Krishna等,2017年),VEDJE在两个检索方向上一致地改进了R@1,比对了第一级检索器. 在MSR-VTT上,以微调的VideoCLIP-XL第一阶段(图1)达到59.8文本到视频R@1. 在VideoPrism配置中,每个样本帧只分配出一个缓存的令牌,将缓存存储量减少4倍到每个视频的12个KiB,同时在0.2分之内保留了T2V R@1. 受控比较评价缓存结构,地物变化培训和联合评分,同时完全平稳地测量基准实际检索延迟.

blocks.en: Contributions. We make three contributions: 1. Compact frame-indexed video caches: Building on cached joint encoding, we compress information within sampled frames while retaining separate frame groups, giving the joint scorer access to evidence from across the sequence under a fixed storage budget. 2. Feature-change supervision for compression: We train the compressed representation with future-delta feature prediction, improving retrieval under tight storage budgets without an inference-time predictor. 3. Accuracy and efficiency evaluation: Across four benchmarks, VEDJE improves R@1 in both directions over matched first stages. On MSR-VTT, it raises fine-tuned VideoCLIP-XL from 56.2 to 59.8 T2V R@1 with approximately 157M total online parameters. The VideoPrism configuration preserves T2V recall within 0.2 points with a fourfold-smaller 12 KiB cache.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 我们作出三项贡献: 1. 压缩帧索引视频缓存: 以缓存联合编码为基础,在样本框架内压缩信息,同时保留单独的帧组,让联合计分员在固定存储预算下从整个序列中获取证据. 2. 用于压缩的特性变化监督: 我们用未来三角洲的特征预测来训练压缩的表示, 改善在紧张的存储预算下检索, 没有推断时间的预测器。 3. 准确性和效率评价: 在四个基准中,VEDJE改进了两个方向的R@1,与第一阶段相匹配。 在MSR-VTT上,它将微调的VideoCLIP-XL从56.2升至59.8 T2V R@1,在线总参数约为157M. VideoPrism配置在0.2分内保留了T2V回想,并有4倍小的12个KiB缓存.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Dual encoders for video-text retrieval. CLIP-style contrastive retrieval stages embed videos and queries independently and score by inner product ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Luo et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) ; efficiency variants further compress stage 1 ( Tian et al., 2024a ; Tian et al., 2024b ) . This dot product enables fast candidate retrieval, but forming the video embedding before the query arrives permanently fixes the visual representation without cross-modal interaction.
blocks.zh: 视频文本检索的双重编码器。 CLIP风格的对比取回阶段独立地嵌入了视频和查询并按内出产品得分(拉德福德等,2021;罗等,2022;王等,2024a;王等,2024b;赵等,2024;效率变体进一步压缩阶段). 1 (天等,2024a;天等,2024b.). 这个点产品可以快速地进行候选检索,但在查询到达前形成嵌入的视频永久地修正了视觉表现而无需交叉模式交互.

blocks.en: Late interaction and multi-vector matching. Late interaction stores richer unimodal token banks and aggregates similarities at query time ( Khattab and Zaharia, 2020 ; Yao et al., 2022 ; Reddy et al., 2025 ) . While multi-token caches preserve detail, the query and cached tokens never share a joint encoder. EERCF ( Tian et al., 2024a ) instead pairs a trained temporal encoder with parameter-free text-gated feature aggregation. We compare with EERCF on a shared CLIP ViT-B/16 architecture and separately evaluate VEDJE on candidates from its released ViT-B/32 retriever.
blocks.zh: 后期互动和多向量匹配. 后期互动存储了更丰富的单行道符号银行和查询时间的相近之处(Khattab and Zaharia, 2020; Yao等人, 2022;Reddy等人, 2025)。 虽然多托肯缓存保存了细节,但查询和缓存的代号从未共享过联合编码器. EERCF (Tian等, 2024a) 取而代之的是,将一个经过训练的时间编码器与无参数文本的特性聚合相配. 我们用共享的CLIP VIT-B/16架构与EERCF进行比较,并从其发布的VIT-B/32检索器中单独评价VEDJE的候选人.

blocks.en: Joint rerankers for vision-language retrieval. Joint rerankers restore pairwise inspection. For images, BLIP variants ( Li et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023a ) establish the recipe and Edje ( Taraday et al., 2026 ) makes it deployable by caching compressed visual tokens. Edje also outlines prospective video extensions using temporal compression and positional encodings. For video, CrossTVR ( Dai et al., 2025 ) applies multi-grained cross-attention to selected frame- and video-level visual tokens, while multimodal LLM (MLLM) rerankers ( Ko et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) place multi-billion-parameter decoders directly on the query path. VEDJE instead builds a compact, reusable cache that enables fine-grained joint attention with a lightweight 33M encoder.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言检索联合排名. 联合调整器恢复双向检查. 对于图像,BLIP的变体(Li等,2022;Li等,2023a)建立了食谱,而Edje(Taraday等,2026)则通过缓存被压缩的可视标志来被可被使用. Edje还用时间压缩和位置编码来勾勒出未来的视频扩展. 对于视频,CrossTVR(Dai等,2025年)对所选的帧和视频平面视觉符号采用多纹交叉意向,而多式LLM(MLLM)重排(Ko等,2025年;Lee等,2025年;Liu等,2025年)则将数十亿参数解码器直接放入查询路径. VEDJE转而构建了可压缩,可再用缓存,能与轻量级33M编码器进行精细的联想.

blocks.en:
Where VEDJE sits. VEDJE targets cached joint reranking for video; its closest neighbour is Edje ’s image-caching recipe ( Taraday et al., 2026 ) .
VEDJE develops and evaluates a video cache that compresses information within sampled frames while retaining separate representations across sampled times. Feature-change supervision improves retrieval from the compressed representation, and a lightweight joint encoder combines the cached evidence with the first-stage relevance estimate. Matched-budget comparisons show the benefit of retaining separate frame groups over pooling, while cache-size ablations measure how feature-change supervision helps at each budget. These results connect the organization and training of the cache to the retrieval accuracy it supports.
blocks.zh:
VEDJE坐在这里。 VEDJE的目标是缓存的联合重排视频;其最接近的邻居是Edje的图像取景配方(Taraday等,2026年).
VEDJE开发并评价一个视频缓存,该缓存在被采样帧内压缩信息,同时保留不同被采样时间的单独表示. 地物变化监督改进了从压缩表达式的检索,轻量级联合编码器将缓存证据与第一阶段关联性估计相结合. 相匹配的预算比较显示,保留单独的框架组而不是集合的好处,而缓存大小缩放则衡量改变特性监督如何帮助每个预算。 这些结果将缓存的组织和培训与其支持的检索准确性联系起来。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: VEDJE replaces query-time video encoding with a cache-design problem : the visual backbone runs once per video, offline, and writes a compact representation that a small joint encoder later reads at query time, alongside the query text and the scalar first-stage score. The cache must be small enough to ship at index scale while retaining evidence across the sampled sequence for later queries. Figure 2 groups the three components that the rest of the section develops: (A) the offline cache, (B) the training-only feature-change supervision, and (C) the online reranker that reads it.

blocks.en: 3.2 A Frame-Indexed Cache across the Sampled Sequence
blocks.zh: 3.2 跨样本序列的帧缓存

blocks.en: The cache Z ⁡ ( v ) Z(v) must satisfy two opposing constraints. It must be small enough to ship per video at index scale, and it must retain evidence across the sampled sequence for a compact joint encoder to compare with future queries. A single global clip vector uses little storage but collapses the sequence into one representation; storing every patch preserves separate frame features at a much higher cost. VEDJE resolves the tension by compressing each frame-indexed feature slice to a small token bank and placing that bank at its temporal position.

blocks.en: VEDJE is evaluated on MSR-VTT ( Xu et al., 2016 ) , MSVD ( Chen and Dolan, 2011 ) , DiDeMo ( Hendricks et al., 2017 ) , and ActivityNet ( Krishna et al., 2017 ) , using standard splits and Recall@ K K in both retrieval directions: text-to-video (T2V) and video-to-text (V2T). Recall values are percentages; absolute differences are percentage points. A first-stage retriever returns the top- N c N_{\mathrm{c}} candidates (default N c = 20 N_{\mathrm{c}}{=}20 ), which VEDJE then reranks from cached video tokens. The default VEDJE configuration uses a 64-token BF16 cache, the VideoPrism prior ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , and prediction horizon ℋ = { 3 } \mathcal{H}=\{3\} . A variant is written VEDJE S1 \text{VEDJE{}}_{\mathrm{S1}} , where the subscript identifies the backbone used for retrieval and cached features: VideoPrism (VP), VideoCLIP-XL (VCLIP) ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , or Perception Encoder (PE) ( Bolya et al., 2025 ) . Non-default cache sizes are appended to the variant name. Parenthesized gains report absolute R@1 improvements over the matched first-stage retriever. The default joint reranker is MiniLM-L12-uncased ( Wang et al., 2020 ) , a compact 12-layer language model with ∼ \sim 33M parameters. It jointly scores cached video tokens alongside query text for T2V, and alongside candidate captions for an indexed video for V2T. Each VEDJE variant constructs its cache from the corresponding visual backbone and uses that backbone's video embeddings as contrastive training targets (Appendix Table 7 ). The cache retains compressed patch features for joint scoring, whereas the contrastive objective uses the corresponding video-level embedding as a training target. During reranker training, the feature encoder remains frozen while the compressor and joint scorer are optimized. ZS and FT describe the first-stage retriever; the reranker is trained in both settings. The CLIP control uses CLIP features and contrastive targets throughout (Table 2 ). The video input uses 16 uniformly sampled frames. The joint scorer accepts up to 64 text tokens including special tokens; Appendix A.2 gives the architecture and input budgets.

Text encoding and index search are shared by both configurations, so reducing the visual sequence affects only part of the complete-query cost. Their difference grows as the scorer processes more candidates: at 100, the 16-token cache reduces latency from 7.83 to 6.33 ms. Compression also reduces the video payload read for each query. The appendix separates cache-residency effects from device-resident scoring (Appendix A.6 ) and reports candidate-count sensitivity (Appendix A.9 ).

blocks.en: Cache residency directly affects retrieval latency: at 100 candidates, the 64-token model requires 7.8 ms under warm NVMe reads and 11.1 ms under cold reads. The first-stage search index is separate from these payloads. Appendix A.6 breaks down cache residency and isolates complete-query latency from device-resident reranking. Offline visual encoding and cache construction are paid once during indexing and amortized across all subsequent queries.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: A reusable video cache must retain useful evidence before its future queries are known. VEDJE addresses this constraint by compressing features within sampled frames while keeping evidence from different times separately accessible. Matched comparisons show the value of this organization, and feature-change supervision improves retrieval from the compressed representation. Across four benchmarks, the resulting cache supports gains over first-stage retrieval, including a fine-tuned first stage. These findings establish a practical route to joint video search in which compact evidence is computed once and reused for later queries.
blocks.zh: 一个可重复使用的视频缓存必须保留有用的证据才能得知其未来的查询. VEDJE通过在抽样框架内压缩特征,同时从不同的时间单独取取证据来解决这一制约. 相匹配的比较显示这个组织的价值,改变特性的监督可以改善从压缩的表述中检索的情况. 在四个基准中,产生的缓存支持第一阶段检索的收益,包括经过微调的第一阶段。 这些调查结果确定了联合视频搜索的实用途径,即一次计算紧凑的证据,再用于以后的询问。

blocks.en: The cache is query-blind : Z ⁡ ( v ) Z(v) is written once and serves every later query about v v , so selectively reading or expanding the cache at query time is a natural extension. The cache also depends on a fixed visual backbone and compressor : updating either requires re-indexing the corpus. The first and second stages are not currently trained jointly; closing that loop is another direction. Finally, the four benchmarks here (MSR-VTT, MSVD, DiDeMo, ActivityNet) use English captions and web-sourced videos. These evaluations span different video lengths, but do not establish performance on multilingual video retrieval.
blocks.zh: 缓存是查询-盲:Z QQ (v) Z (v) 写作一次,服务于以后每一次关于v v 的查询,因此有选择地读取或扩展查询时间的缓存是自然的扩展. 缓存还依赖于固定的视觉主干线和压缩机:更新要么需要重新索引实体。 第一阶段和第二阶段目前没有共同培训;关闭这一循环是另一个方向。 最后,这里的四个基准(MSR-VTT,MSVD,DiDeMo,ActiveNet)使用英文字幕和由网络来源的视频. 这些评价跨越不同的视频长度,但并不确立多语种视频检索的绩效.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work collects no new data and involves no crowdsourcing, human-subject study, biometric processing, facial recognition, or identity annotation. Experiments use the established MSR-VTT, MSVD, DiDeMo, and ActivityNet benchmarks under their original release terms. These web-video datasets can nevertheless contain identifiable people, and their historical collection and consent documentation may not satisfy current expectations for every downstream use. Making semantic video retrieval cheaper can also increase cross-collection re-identification or surveillance risk when combined with external identity systems. Deployments should therefore require lawful and authorized data use, role-based access, purpose limitation, query logging and auditing, restrictions on identity-oriented searches, retention limits, and human review for surveillance or biometric applications. Automated query moderation can complement these controls.
blocks.zh: 这项工作没有收集新的数据,也不涉及众包、人文研究、生物鉴别处理、面部识别或身份说明。 实验使用既定的MSR-VTT,MSVD,DiDeMo,以及ActiveNet在原始发布条款下的基准. 然而,这些网络视频数据集可以包含可识别的人,其历史收集和同意文件可能无法满足当前对下游使用量的预期。 使语义视频检索更便宜,也可以增加交叉收集再识别或监视的风险,如果与外部身份系统结合的话. 因此,部署需要合法和经授权的数据使用、以角色为基础的访问、目的限制、查询记录和审计、对面向身份的搜索的限制、保留限制以及对监视或生物鉴别应用的人力审查。 自动查询节制可以补充这些控制.

A.4 Cache Quantization
blocks.zh: A.4 缓存定量

blocks.en: The default cache uses BF16. The FP8-E4M3 and FP4-E2M1 controls in Table 16 quantize the stored cache and dequantize it to FP32 before joint encoding. Reranker and score-encoder weights retain their training precision. Storage counts the nominal packed payload: 0.5, 1, or 2 bytes per element for FP4, FP8, or BF16, excluding metadata. The controls measure retrieval accuracy after cache quantization, with floating-point inference in every condition.
blocks.zh: 默认缓存使用 BF16. 表16中的FP8-E4M3和FP4-E2M1控制将所储存的缓存分解并分解为FP32后再进行联合编码. 分数计分器和分数计分器重量保持了训练精度. 储存计算了名义上装入的有效载荷:FP4、FP8或BF16,不包括元数据,每元素0.5、1或2字节。 控制器在缓存分解后测量检索精度,每个条件都有浮点推论.

blocks.en: A.6 End-to-End Latency and Cache I/O
blocks.zh: A.6 端到端的延迟和缓存 I/O

blocks.en: We time VP-backed MSR-VTT T2V retrieval on one NVIDIA L40S with one query per batch and all its candidates processed together. Measurements are medians of 200 runs after 30 warmups. The approximately 4.3 ms stage-1 reference includes query-text encoding and 0.03 to 0.04 ms candidate search. End-to-end timings additionally include prior processing, cache fetching and host-to-device transfer, and joint scoring. With caches already on device, the FP16 reranker takes 3.03/1.73 ms for 64/16 tokens at N c = 100 N_{\mathrm{c}}{=}100 ; PyTorch CUDA peak resident memory is 0.99/0.78 GB for this component.
blocks.zh: 我们把VP支持的MSR-VTT T2V检索时间用一个NVIDIA L40S,每个批次有一个查询,其所有考生一起处理. 测量是30个热身后200个运行的中位数。 大约4.3ms阶段一的参考包括查询-文本编码和0.03至0.04ms候选搜索. 端到端计时额外包括前期处理,缓存取取取和主机到端调取,以及联合评分. 随着设备上的缓存,FP16重排机在N c = 100 N_{\-mathrm{c}}{=}-100时为 64.16个令牌取出3.03/1.73 ms;PyTorch CUDA最高峰常住内存为0.99/0.78 GB.

blocks.en: Table 8: VP-backed MSR-VTT T2V latency for 64-token caches. Values are milliseconds, measured end to end under host-RAM and batched NVMe reads; warm and cold denote the reported cache-residency conditions.
blocks.zh: 表8:用于64个托肯缓存的由VP支撑的MSR-VTT T2V latency. 值为毫秒,在主机-RAM下被测量到末端,并分批的NVMe读取;温暖和寒冷表示所报告的缓存-滞留条件.

blocks.en: At N c = 20 N_{\mathrm{c}}{=}20 , host-cache fetching and copying accounts for 2.4%/1.2% of end-to-end query time for 64/16 tokens; the share remains at most 5.5% through 100 candidates. Warm NVMe reads approach host-RAM latency, while cold reads are slower.
blocks.zh: 在N c = 20 N_{\ mathrm{ c}}{=} 20 中,主机抓取和复制占 64/16 令牌端到端查询时间的 2.4%/1.2%;该份额通过100 个候选者维持在最多5.5%. 温暖的NVMe读取了接近主机-RAM latency,而寒冷读取则较慢.

blocks.en: Multiplying the per-video payload by corpus size gives 12.3/49.2 GB for one million videos and 0.123/0.492 TB for ten million at 16/64 BF16 tokens. At 16 tokens, nominal packed FP4 payload is 3.07 GB per million videos. These calculations count cached tensor bytes, excluding container metadata and the first-stage index; they are storage extrapolations.

blocks.en: At two bytes per element, storing 256 patch vectors and one frame vector for each of 16 sampled frames requires 6.02 MiB per video. VEDJE stores 64 vectors of dimension 384, reducing this payload to 48 KiB, a factor of 128.5. The 16-token configuration uses 12 KiB.

blocks.en: A.14 Future-Delta Loss Horizon Sweep
blocks.zh: A.14 未来-德尔塔损失地平线扫描

blocks.en: We selected h = 3 h{=}3 by three-fold cross-validation on the MSR-VTT training set, using held-out training folds for validation and leaving the evaluation set untouched. This horizon gave the most consistent validation R@1 across folds, with stability assessed by its standard deviation. The test-set sweep in Table 20 shows sensitivity to the prediction offset: among the tested horizons, h = 3 h{=}3 improves R@1 over the no-auxiliary reference in both retrieval directions.
blocks.zh: 我们在MSR-VTT训练集上通过三倍交叉验证选择了h = 3 h{=}3,使用被搁置的训练折叠进行验证,使评价集不受影响. 这个地平线提供了最一致的验证R@1跨折叠,其稳定性由其标准偏差来评估. 表20中的测试集扫描显示对预测的敏感度相抵:在测试的地平线中,h = 3 h{=}3比两个检索方向的无辅助参考值改进了R@1.

blocks.en: No horizon dominates every R@K cutoff. Relative to the no-auxiliary reference of 54.0/53.6 T2V/V2T R@1, h = 2 h{=}2 gives 53.8/53.0 and h = 4 h{=}4 gives 54.4/53.0. The benefit therefore depends on the offset; the default h = 3 h{=}3 gives the strongest R@1 result in both directions.

blocks.en: A.15 Reranker Text-Encoder Control
blocks.zh: A.15 重排文本编码器控制

blocks.en: This control measures the effect of increasing reranker capacity while retaining the cache and training setup. Replacing the default 33M joint encoder with BERT-base ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) (110M parameters) adds 77M reranker parameters, a 3.3 × 3.3\times increase, but yields small mixed changes on MSR-VTT 1ka.
blocks.zh: 这种控制测量了在保留缓存和培训设置的同时增加再排行的能力的效果。 以BERT-base取代默认的33M联合编码器(Devlin等,2019年)(110M参数),增加了77M重排参数,增加了3.3×3.3\时,但在MSR-VTT 1ka上产生小的混合变化.

blocks.en: Table 21: MSR-VTT 1ka reranker-backbone control, with Recall@ K K in percent. The BERT-base ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) control raises the added reranker size from 33M to 110M parameters.
blocks.zh: 表21: MSR-VTT 1ka 重排后骨控制, 百分比为KK。 BERT-base(Devlin等,2019年)控制将所添加的后排大小从33M提高到110M参数.

blocks.en: BERT-base ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) improves T2V R@5 and R@10 by 0.6 and 0.1 percentage points but lowers R@1 by 1.7 (T2V) and 0.6 (V2T) percentage points despite using 3.3 × 3.3\times more reranker parameters. Increasing capacity under this training schedule does not improve R@1.
blocks.zh: BERT-base(Devlin等,2019年)将T2V R@5和R@10改进了0.6和0.1个百分点,但将R@1降低1.7(T2V)和0.6(V2T)百分点,尽管使用了3.3×3.3\的更重排参数. 根据这一培训时间表增加能力并不能改善R@1.

blocks.en: For indexed retrieval, CLIP4Clip ( Luo et al., 2022 ) , X-CLIP ( Ma et al., 2022 ) , EERCF ( Tian et al., 2024a ) , and Video-ColBERT ( Reddy et al., 2025 ) can reuse video representations computed independently of the text. We count text-encoding and learned-scoring weights from their public architectures. Figure 1 uses the reproduced CLIP4Clip B/16 result of 46.4 from Tian et al. (2024a) , labeled as a reproduction in its source table. The CLIP text tower and logit scale contain approximately 63.4M parameters. X-CLIP’s scoring matrices add approximately 0.5M parameters; EERCF’s coarse-score and frame-score matrices add approximately 0.3M, alongside its parameter-free text-gated interaction block. The Video-ColBERT count covers the full 110.3M-parameter SigLIP-B/16 text module, including its output head; the paper does not specify whether its tokenwise scorer uses that head.
blocks.zh: 对于索引检索,CLIP4Clip(Luo等,2022年),X-CLIP(Ma等,2022年),EERCF(Tian等,2024年a),和Video-ColBERT(Reddy等,2025年)可以重复使用独立于文本计算出来的视频表示. 我们从他们的公共建筑中计算出文字编码和学分加权。 图1使用所复制的由Tian等人(2024年a)46.4所生成的CLIP4Clip B/16结果,在其出处表中标注为复制. CLIP的文本塔和日志尺度包含约63.4M参数. X-CLIP的评分矩阵会增加大约0.5M参数;EERCF的粗分和帧分矩阵会增加大约0.3M,连同其参数无文本的交互块. 视频-哥伦比亚 计数覆盖了完整的110.3M-参数SigLIP-B/16文本模块,包括其输出头;纸张没有具体说明其象征性的分分数器是否使用该头.

blocks.en: The total combines the first-stage text encoder with the approximately 33M joint reranker and its small scoring heads. Public text-encoder architectures contain approximately 109.6M parameters for VideoPrism ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , 124.0M for VideoCLIP-XL ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , and 354.0M for PE-Core-B/16 ( Bolya et al., 2025 ) . Table 22 retains the reported VEDJE total estimates of 143M, 157M, and 387M. The visual backbone, compressor, and training-only predictor run during indexing or training.

blocks.en: The LamRA reproduction and CaRe-DPO results are reported together by Lee et al. (2025) , using VideoChat-Flash-7B. The public model’s Qwen2 base decoder contains approximately 7.6B parameters, including its untied input embeddings and output head. This is the component counted in Table 22 and Figure 1 . The complete pipelines also use a first-stage query encoder and fine-tuning components, including any unmerged adapters and CaRe-DPO’s role embeddings. The reproduced LamRA result is 59.7 R@1, compared with 59.8 for VEDJE at approximately 157M online parameters; the base decoder alone has about 49 times that parameter count. CaRe-DPO reaches higher recall at 64.1 and remains visible in the comparison. CrossTVR-Large’s ( Dai et al., 2025 ) online/offline parameter partition was not established, so its accuracy is listed without a cost coordinate.
blocks.zh: LamRA复制和Care-DPO的结果由Lee等人(2025年)共同报告, (原始内容存档于2019-10-10). Chat-Flash-7B. 公用模型的Qune2基解码器包含约7.6B参数,包括其不附带条件的输入嵌入和输出头. 这是表22和图1所统计的部分。 完整的管道还使用了第一阶段的查询编码器和微调组件,包括任何未起伏的适配器和CaRe-DPO的作用嵌入. 所复制的LamRA结果为59.7 R@1,而VEDJE在线参数约为157M;仅基解码器就有大约49倍于参数计数. Care-DPO的召回率较高,为64.1,在比较中仍然可见. CrossTVR-Large's(Dai等,2025年)在线/离线参数分区没有建立,因此其准确性没有成本坐标.

blocks.en: Parameter footprint describes the size of the models used during a query. Operation count, sequence length, candidate count, hardware, and cache access also determine execution time. Section 4.7 and Appendix A.6 report measured VEDJE query latency, including text encoding, search, cache access, and scoring. Figure 1 provides the broader comparison under the stated parameter accounting.
blocks.zh: 参数脚印描述查询时使用的模型大小. 操作计数,序列长度,候选计数,硬件,和缓存访问也决定了执行时间. 第4.7节和附录A.6报告测量了VEDJE查询间隔,包括文本编码,搜索,缓存访问和评分. 图1提供了所述参数核算下更广泛的比较。
